# Third-party files

## `unitree-g1-openarm-adapter.stl`

- Source: [lerobot/unitree-g1-hardware-modifications](https://huggingface.co/datasets/lerobot/unitree-g1-hardware-modifications),
  `STLs/unitree-g1-openarm-adapter.stl`, revision `a253ba15672f55161b688fc824393ec0b946dbf0`
  (the millimetre-scale revision; import as mm at 100%).
- License: [Apache License 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0), © the LeRobot / Hugging Face authors.
- Unmodified copy. `../build_interface_g1.py` uses only its G1 plug (everything below y = 16.5 mm)
  and replaces the OpenArm plate with the Pinc'Open one.
- According to that dataset's README, the plug geometry matches Wuji Technology's
  [G1 docking adapter](https://github.com/wuji-technology/wuji-description/tree/main/hand/attachment/unitree-g1-attachment) (MIT).
